# ponte_agent_group_member (Resource)

Membership of one agent in one agent group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every active agent labelled team=claims joins the group.
data "ponte_agents" "claims" {
  labels = { team = "claims" }
}

resource "ponte_agent_group_member" "claims" {
  for_each = toset(data.ponte_agents.claims.ids)
  group_id = ponte_agent_group.claims.id
  agent_id = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String)
- `group_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) group_id/agent_id.
